company.name: Allbirds
company.oneLiner: Allbirds sells shoes, socks, and apparel made from wool, tree fiber, and sugarcane, mainly direct to consumers online.
company.customers: Men and women buying everyday sneakers, slip-ons, flats, and sandals online, plus shoppers who buy through other retailers.

blueprint.headline: Allbirds sells the same silhouettes in several materials under a strict return policy, so the agents to build first turn returns and eligibility questions into decisions merchandising and support can act on.

agents.name: Return Reason Analyst
agents.role: Groups every return by style, size, and material and tells merchandising which fit or material problem is driving it.
agents.trigger: Every Monday at 07:00, covering returns logged in the previous week
does: Reads return reasons and free-text comments for each style, such as Tree Runner NZ versus Cruiser
Separates size complaints from material complaints by comparing the same silhouette across wool, tree, and canvas
Writes a one-page internal brief with the three biggest movers and the example comments behind each

tools.name: Product catalog by style and material

humanGate.detail: It only reads return data and writes an internal brief. It changes no product, price, or customer record.

agents.evidence: The site sells one silhouette in several materials (Cruiser, Canvas Cruiser, Wool Cruiser Waterproof) and runs a 30-day return window for unworn items.
agents.impact: Merchandising sees within a week whether a new colorway or material has a fit problem, instead of finding out from end-of-season return totals.

agents.name: Return Eligibility Desk
agents.role: Answers return and refund questions by checking the order against the published policy and drafting the reply.
agents.trigger: When a support conversation is tagged as a return or refund question
does: Looks up the order: purchase date, country, whether return coverage was bought, and whether any item was Final Sale
Flags purchases made through another retailer, which must go back to that retailer
Drafts a reply that states the outcome and the exact policy condition it rests on

humanGate.detail: Every customer reply is sent by an agent after review. Any exception to policy (outside 30 days, Final Sale, worn items) needs a team lead.

agents.evidence: The policy has several conditions that decide each case: 30 days, unworn with tags, Final Sale excluded, optional return coverage, refunds only in the country of purchase.
agents.impact: Most return questions become a reviewed one-click reply, and exceptions are decided by the people allowed to make them.

agents.name: Material Claims Checker
agents.role: Checks new product pages and campaign copy for material and climate claims before they publish.
agents.trigger: When a product page or campaign draft moves to ready for review
does: Finds every material or climate claim in the draft, such as plant-based, regenerative wool, or net zero carbon
Matches each claim against an approved claims register and the substantiation behind it
Returns the draft with unsupported or changed wording highlighted and the approved phrasing beside it

humanGate.detail: Nothing publishes on the agent's say-so. A sustainability or legal reviewer approves every page that contains a flagged claim.

agents.evidence: The site leans on material claims across the catalog: wool, tree fiber, sugarcane, Terralux described as plant-based, and M0.0NSHOT Zero described as a net zero carbon shoe.
agents.impact: Claims stay consistent across hundreds of pages and launches, and reviewers spend their time on genuinely new wording.

agents.name: Holiday Markdown Watcher
agents.role: Tracks sell-through by style and size during sales and proposes which markdowns to deepen, hold, or end.
agents.trigger: Daily at 06:00 while a sale such as the Black Friday Early Access event is live
does: Reads sell-through and remaining stock for every discounted style and size
Flags sizes that will sell out before the sale ends and styles that are not moving at the current discount
Drafts a markdown change list with the reason for each line

humanGate.detail: Every price change goes to a draft price list. A merchandiser approves the list before any price changes on the site.

agents.evidence: The site runs a Holiday Sale with Black Friday Early Access at up to 70 percent off select styles.
agents.impact: Markdowns follow what is actually selling by size, so popular sizes are not discounted into stockouts and slow styles do not wait for the next review.

firstBuild.why: It is read-only, the data already exists in the returns system, and its first weekly brief shows whether the other agents are worth building.
scope: Pull 90 days of returns with reason codes and comments
Group by style, size, and material, comparing the same silhouette across materials
Write a weekly brief to one merchandising channel
Review the first four briefs with merchandising and tune the groupings

blueprint.nonObvious: Because Allbirds makes the same silhouette in wool, tree fiber, canvas, and Terralux, its returns can separate a sizing problem from a material problem: if the Cruiser is returned for fit in every material, it is the last; if only one material, it is the fabric. Single-material brands cannot run that comparison.
caveats: Curated by hand from the public site, not produced by a live run.
Return volumes, support tools, and order systems are not visible on the site; tools are named by category.
Wholesale and retail-partner operations were not visible beyond the note that third-party purchases return to that retailer.
